# Chris McCann — Field Notes

> Consciousness research. Leadership. The gap between what leaders do and what they're carrying when they do it. Newsletter, assessment, book. Co-authoring with Dr. Carlos Warter (Park Street Press, spring 2027).

Chris McCann spent fifteen years leading corporate sales teams in SaaS. Field Notes is where he works through the intersection of consciousness research and organizational life — what happens in rooms before anyone speaks, what the body registers that the calendar doesn't, and why smart leaders keep making the same choices. Spare, observational, first-person. No frameworks. Written for leaders who sense something is off but can't name it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chrismccann.co/): Overview of Field Notes, recent writing, newsletter sign-up, and field assessment.
- [Field Notes — All Essays](https://chrismccann.co/field-notes/): Index of all essays on consciousness, leadership, and what happens in sales rooms that the deck doesn't capture.
- [About](https://chrismccann.co/about/): Background on Chris McCann — fifteen years in corporate SaaS, bipolar diagnosis at 49, co-authoring a book on consciousness and leadership with Dr. Carlos Warter.
- [Retreats](https://chrismccann.co/retreats/): Private leadership retreats with Chris McCann and Dr. Carlos Warter. Small group. By application.
- [Field Assessment](https://chrismccann.co/field-assessment/): A short assessment that measures where a leader sits on the spectrum from autopilot to integrated presence.

## Essays

- [The Room Knew First](https://chrismccann.co/field-notes/the-room-knew-first/): A rep closed the biggest deal in company history. The room felt empty. On presence, performance, and what rooms register before anyone speaks.
- [Your Body Knows Before You Do](https://chrismccann.co/field-notes/your-body-knows-before-you-do/): On somatic awareness in leadership. The body processes risk and opportunity before the conscious mind does. The research explains why.
- [You Don't Need Ayahuasca. You Need to Pay Attention.](https://chrismccann.co/field-notes/you-dont-need-ayahuasca/): On executive retreats, manufactured breakthroughs, and the cheaper attention that was available all along.
- [The One-Minute Test](https://chrismccann.co/field-notes/the-one-minute-test/): On the gap between what leaders think they said and what the other person heard. A practice that takes sixty seconds.

## About the Author

Chris McCann opened Boston Chicken locations at twenty. Managed a Hooters at twenty-two. Spent fifteen years leading go-to-market organizations in emerging SaaS categories. Diagnosed with bipolar disorder at forty-nine. Co-authoring a book on consciousness and leadership with Dr. Carlos Warter, a psychiatrist and author who has spent fifty years studying consciousness from inside clinical practice. Park Street Press, spring 2027. Field Notes is where the questions live before the book has answers for them.

## Newsletter

Field Notes publishes every two weeks on Thursdays via Beehiiv. The writing circles the same territory: what's happening in leadership that hasn't been slowed down enough to notice. Subscribe at https://chrismccann.co.
